raw_definition.description: ISO 8601 datetime string.

The outcomes that map to ACCOUNTED. Half of the closed-world mapping being declared rather than assumed: the verifier reads this enum, so a new outcome joins the census by being declared here and cannot acquire a disposition by resembling one.

ABSENT.description: A reviewer states the unit is not present in the source. An answer about the unit, not about one region, which is why it outranks the region-level verdicts when both are recorded.

EXCLUDED.description: A reviewer ruled the region out of scope by a declared rule.

READ.description: A reading of the unit exists and reaches its pixels.

UNREADABLE.description: A reviewer looked and the content cannot be read.

VERIFIED_BLANK.description: A reviewer looked and the region carries no content.

NEGATIVE_AUDIT.description: A named bounded artifact was inspected for an absent item.

REVIEWER_INFERENCE.description: The reviewer derived the assertion from named evidence.

SOURCE_EXPLICIT.description: The inspected source states or directly links the assertion.

raw_definition.description: Types of ATT&CK domain entities.

CAPABILITY.description: A capability required or produced by a technique.

DATA_SOURCE.description: A source of telemetry for detecting a technique.

MITIGATION.description: A defensive measure that reduces technique effectiveness.

TACTIC.description: An ATT&CK tactic (phase of an attack).

raw_definition.description: Types of events in the ATT&CK domain.

ALTERNATIVE_FOUND.description: An alternative chain was found when the primary was blocked.

CHAIN_CONSTRUCTED.description: An attack chain was constructed from technique nodes.

CHAIN_EVALUATED.description: A chain was evaluated for viability against mitigations.

raw_definition.description: Types of relationships between ATT&CK entities.

BELONGS_TO_TACTIC.description: Technique belongs to this tactic phase.

CHAIN_LINK.description: Technique A enables technique B in a sequential attack chain. Derived from Attack Flow corpus.

DETECTS.description: Data source can detect this technique.

MITIGATES.description: Mitigation reduces effectiveness of this technique.

PROVIDES_CAPABILITY.description: Technique provides this capability upon success.

REQUIRES_CAPABILITY.description: Technique requires this capability to execute.

raw_definition.description: Types of computed signals in the ATT&CK domain.

CHAIN_VIABILITY.description: Whether a proposed attack chain is viable given current mitigations and technique prerequisites.

MITIGATION_COVERAGE.description: Fraction of techniques in a chain that are mitigated.

raw_definition.description: What happened to the call. Distinct from what the document said: a completed attempt over a blank region is COMPLETED, and the blankness is the reviewer's verdict, not the call's status.

COMPLETED.description: The provider returned a response that was retained.

FAILED.description: The call was made and did not produce a usable response.

UNAVAILABLE.description: The call could not be made. unavailable_reason states why.

raw_definition.description: What a bundle claims to be. The distinction exists because "we hold this document and have not read it" is an honest state, and a profile that refuses it would reject the situation its first real consumer is in.

FINISHED_READING.description: A completed reading. Every declared unit must be accounted for, and the source class's own thresholds decide whether it succeeded.

REGISTRATION.description: The source is held and not yet read. May carry no readings, and may never be counted as evidence that an adapter conforms.

raw_definition.description: The 6 core CYP450 isoforms responsible for ~80-90% of CYP drug metabolism.

CYP3A4.description: Cytochrome P450 3A4. Metabolizes ~50% of CYP-pathway drugs.

raw_definition.description: The outcomes that map to CHECK_FAILED. These are attempt states, and a reviewer never inherits them (mandate B2), so they reach the census from AttemptStatus and never from ReviewVerdict.

FAILED.description: The call was made and did not produce a usable response.

UNAVAILABLE.description: The call could not be made.

raw_definition.description: Types of drug-domain entities.
Types of events in the drug interaction domain.

INTERACTION_DETECTED.description: A drug-drug interaction was identified via CYP mechanism tracing.

MECHANISM_TRACED.description: A multi-step interaction mechanism was traced through the KG.

raw_definition.description: Types of relationships between drug-domain entities.

INTERACTS_WITH.description: Two drugs interact via a shared CYP mechanism.

PRODUCES.description: Drug metabolism produces this metabolite (via enzyme).

SUBSTRATE_OF.description: Drug is metabolized by this enzyme.

raw_definition.description: Types of computed signals in the drug interaction domain.

EXPOSURE_CHANGE.description: Estimated fold-change in substrate exposure due to enzyme inhibition or induction.

INTERACTION_RISK.description: Risk level of a drug-drug interaction pair. Computed from inhibition strength, number of shared CYP pathways, and clinical significance data.

raw_definition.description: Lifecycle state of any identifiable entity.
FDA classification of inhibitor/inducer potency.
The pharmacokinetic effect of a drug-drug interaction.

DECREASED_EXPOSURE.description: Substrate plasma concentration decreases (induction of metabolism).

INCREASED_EXPOSURE.description: Substrate plasma concentration increases (inhibition of metabolism).

NO_SIGNIFICANT_EFFECT.description: No clinically significant change in exposure.

raw_definition.description: The specific failure a monitor reports. Closed for the same reason as the category, and paired with error_message, which stays free text and carries the detail. A new code is added here, never invented at a call site.

Why a monitor failed to produce an output. Closed because the arbiter must be able to answer "how many deferrals came from a timeout" with a query rather than a substring search; free-text reasons are provenance that cannot be enforced.

The outcomes that map to NOT_CHECKED. Three ways to go unlooked-at, kept apart because "we never fetched it", "we hold it and never rendered it" and "we rendered it and never looked" are different failures.

NOT_ATTEMPTED.description: A rendering exists and no attempt or reading covers it.

NOT_OBSERVED.description: The unit is not among the units this bundle observed.

NOT_RENDERED.description: The unit is observed and no rendering of it exists.

raw_definition.description: Closed per Ontology Protocol rule 3. The root leaves event_type open; the domain schema narrows it.

OCR_ATTEMPT.description: One execution attempt against one region.

REVIEW_CORRECTION.description: One append-only human review of one reading.

raw_definition.description: Closed vocabulary for protocol responsibility. The authority model turns on role; an open string here would let any caller claim any authority unchecked.

PROPOSED.description: Recorded for inspection but not yet reviewed.

RETIRED.description: Excluded from current analysis without erasing history.

raw_definition.description: Mandate B2. Verified blank, unreadable, unavailable, failed, excluded and absent stay distinct. None may be padded, snapped, or converted into another, here or downstream. UNAVAILABLE and FAILED are attempt states and live in AttemptStatus; a reviewer never inherits them.

ABSENT.description: The unit the region belongs to is not present in the source.

CORRECTED.description: The reviewer produced a different reading of the same region.

EXCLUDED.description: The region is out of scope by a declared rule.

UNREADABLE.description: The region carries content that cannot be read.

VERIFIED_BLANK.description: A reviewer looked and the region carries no content.

raw_definition.description: The 14 ATT&CK Enterprise tactics, ordered by typical attack progression.

What the profile knows about one declared unit, as three first-class values rather than one bit with a silent negative. "We looked and can say what we found", "nobody looked" and "somebody looked and the look failed" are three different answers with three different fixes, and a boolean forces two of them to share a word.
Read by malleus.ocr.verify. A unit outcome carries exactly one disposition, declared by the three enums below and never inferred at a call site.

ACCOUNTED.description: Somebody looked and can say what they found. Blank, unreadable, out of scope and not-present are all answers; only never-looking is not.

CHECK_FAILED.description: Somebody tried to look and the attempt produced no reading. Distinct from NOT_CHECKED because the fix is different: a failed call is retried, an unfetched unit is fetched.

NOT_CHECKED.description: Nobody looked. The profile knows only that a step did not happen, which is an explicit unknown and never a pass.

raw_definition.description: Classification of the agent. Domain projects should constrain this to an enum.
Name or reference of the computation that produces this signal. Domain projects should document algorithms and constrain this to an enum. Examples: appleseed, pagerank, ewma, linear_decay.
MITRE ATT&CK identifier (e.g., T1566, T1059.001, M1049).
The machine attempt that produced this reading, if any.
What happened to the call.
ID of the entity or relationship this signal inheres in. A Signal is a dependent continuant — it cannot exist without a bearer. For trust: the agent-pair relationship. For health: the server entity.
Whether this bundle claims a completed reading or only a registration. A pass means nothing until this says which question was answered.
Exact byte count of the represented source.
Every reading this selection considered.
The capability provided or required by this relation. e.g., "local-code-execution", "domain-admin-credentials", "network-access". Used for REQUIRES_CAPABILITY and PROVIDES_CAPABILITY relations.
ID of the event or agent that caused this event. Follows PROV-O wasInformedBy / wasAssociatedWith pattern.
When this signal value was last computed.
Provider-reported confidence. Uncalibrated by construction and therefore never permitted to control acceptance (mandate B1).
Content address of the exact prompt, config, model and tool identity used. A change here demotes prior readings from current without destroying them (decision C7).
Content address of the corrected reading, when the verdict is CORRECTED.
The human review that produced this reading, if any.
When this was created.
Which CYP450 isoform this enzyme represents.
Bound declaration of classification, local versus remote processing, provider retention, encryption, access, export, deletion and raw-response policy (decision C5).
Free-text description.
Full algorithm-tagged content address. A truncated digest may be displayed and may never be an integrity value.
Therapeutic or pharmacological class of the drug (e.g., "statin", "macrolide antibiotic", "azole antifungal").
When a duration event ended.
Classification of the event. Domain projects should constrain this to an enum.
Evidence records inspected for this assertion.
When the declaration was frozen. Freezing precedes ingest.
Bound isolation declaration. Document text is untrusted data everywhere: it cannot alter prompts, tools, policy, ontology, permissions or execution instructions.
Whether a human verified the selected reading. Cannot be asserted without a retained review record.
Globally unique identifier.
CURIE-like identifiers such as DOI or arXiv identifiers.
FDA-classified potency of inhibition or induction. Applies to INHIBITS and INDUCES relations.
The pharmacokinetic outcome of this interaction. Applies to INTERACTS_WITH relations.
How the required-unit inventory was arrived at and confirmed.
Whether this is a sub-technique of a parent.
Short human-readable record label.
Where the bytes were obtained. Not proof that they are authentic.
Where something was obtained. A locator is a route back to a thing, never evidence that the thing at the end of it is authentic or unchanged.
Free-text description of the interaction mechanism. e.g., "CYP3A4 inhibition reduces simvastatin first-pass metabolism"
IANA media type of the source bytes.

Every plane record this bundle contains. Without it a bundle record names its precommitment and its policies and cannot answer which readings belong to it, so two bundles over the same source class are indistinguishable in the graph.
Content address of the full metric family declaration, including each family's denominator and threshold. The declaration is an artifact, not a graph record (decision 2).
The names of the precommitted coverage metric families. Read by the profile, which refuses a source class declaring none.
Human-readable name.
The units actually present in this bundle.
When the event happened (instantaneous events).
ID of the entity from whose perspective this signal is computed. Null for global/objective signals (e.g., graph density). Set for subjective signals (e.g., trust computed from one agent's viewpoint).
Operating systems / platforms this technique applies to (e.g., "Windows", "Linux", "macOS").
The prior review in an append-only correction chain.
The raster this region is defined over.
Why this reading was selected over the others considered.
The region a reading, attempt or selection is bound to.
The type of relation (has_part, contains, depends_on, etc.). Domain projects should constrain this to an enum.
The exact rendering contract, including resolution and version.
Content address of the request semantics, credentials excluded.

The unit inventory this source class requires, derived from the source and then explicitly confirmed or overridden as a recorded act, so a truncated source cannot certify itself.
Read by malleus.ocr.verify. account_for censuses this inventory, one row per unit, and it is the declared_units denominator every coverage metric family is measured against.
This description read DECLARED UNREAD for a release after account_for began iterating the slot. That is the ABSENT defect pointing the other way: a schema describing behaviour the code no longer lacked. Corrected in 0.13.3.
Still unbuilt, and narrower than the sentence it replaces: decision C2, dependency-closed partial claims. The census says which units are missing; nothing decides which claims may be promoted despite them. C2 needs unit-to-claim closure, claim-to-claim closure, cycle detection and replay semantics, each with its own fixtures, and none is built.
Content address of the raw response, retained under the adopter's declared retention rule.
What the reviewer concluded.
The reading under review. Retained; a review never erases what it reviewed.
The reviewing identity. A bare string until protocol-actor-registration lands, so separateness from the producing identity is recorded and not checked.

The identity that reviewed something. Recorded as declared; malleus does not resolve it to a registered actor, so who a reviewer is, and whether they are separate from the party under review, are claims and not checks.
The reading this selection made current. Must be among the candidates.
Content address of the region selector under its declared profile.

The selector profile this region is expressed in. Replaceable: any profile that emits the same normative intermediate and passes the selector conformance suite takes the default's place with no privilege lost or gained (decision C1).
Classification of the signal. Domain projects should constrain this to an enum. Examples: trust_score, health_score, centrality.
The frozen source class this bundle was ingested under.
Reference to the source Entity.
The source representation this raster was rendered from.
When a duration event began.
The content of an assertion as text. Untrusted data everywhere: it is recorded, quoted and compared, and it never alters interpretation.
Lifecycle status.
Weight or confidence of the relation (0.0 to 1.0).
Which tactic phase this entity belongs to.
Numeric ordering of the tactic in the attack lifecycle. RECONNAISSANCE=1 through IMPACT=14.
Arbitrary classification tags.
Reference to the target Entity.

What a printed date on this class of document means, and whether the class can be ordered by valid time (decision C4). No invented defaults. An undated class is usable for content and carries no timeline.
Content address of the read text. The text itself is untrusted data.
Content address of the transport metadata, which is scanned for credential-shaped material before it is bound.
Why the call could not be made. Required reading when status is UNAVAILABLE.

Which declared unit of the source class this rendering is of, for example a page. Without it a bundle can say how many units it required and how many it observed, and cannot say what happened to any one of them, so coverage stays a count rather than an account.
When this was last modified.
Current computed value. Interpretation is signal-type specific. Often 0.0–1.0 but not constrained at the root level (domain decides range and semantics).
Atomic binding of one accepted decision to the exact candidate applied during the same ledger event. This records knowledge commitment, not action authorization or execution.
Domain ontologies define concrete action payload types.

Capability of acting, deciding, or bearing responsibility. Aligned with PROV:Agent and BDI model. Agency is a trait, not a taxonomic position: an entity CAN act, it is not defined by acting. Apply this mixin to any entity class that needs volitional behavior.
An event in the ATT&CK domain.
A computed signal in the ATT&CK domain.
Deterministic authorization control policy bound to an exact set of authority monitors before an action is proposed.
Ordered graph writes and precision-aware temporal boundaries staged against one accepted graph state. A digest-only candidate is not replayable.
A capability required or produced by a Technique.
A source of telemetry used to detect a Technique.
Human-readable description and metadata.
A pharmaceutical compound with known or hypothesized CYP interactions.
An event in the drug interaction domain.
A computed signal in the drug interaction domain.
Root class for all identifiable, enduring things. Aligned with BFO:Independent Continuant. Every domain object that persists through time and needs identity extends this.
A CYP450 enzyme isoform.
Deterministic mapping from exact required monitor outputs to one epistemic verdict.

Something that happens at a point or over an interval. Aligned with BFO:Occurrent / PROV:Activity. Instantaneous events use occurred_at. Processes with duration use started_at / ended_at (Allen's interval algebra).

The container. Binds the frozen source class and the two mandatory policy declarations (decision C5). The profile enforces that a declaration exists and is bound; it never enforces what the declaration says.
Content-addressed declaration of the external graph used to seed accepted graph replay. The graph itself must be supplied and independently match these commitments.

One reading of one region, from exactly one origin. A machine reading names its attempt; a human correction names its review. Never both, so the provenance of a reading is never ambiguous.
An Entity and deliberately not a Signal: a Signal is computed and recomputable from its inputs, and a provider reading is neither. It is retained precisely because it cannot be regenerated.
Anything with a stable, globally unique identity. Aligned with BFO Independent Continuant: exists on its own, bears qualities, participates in processes.
A Drug induces an Enzyme.
A Drug inhibits an Enzyme.
A Drug interacts with another Drug through a CYP mechanism.
Immutable evidence of one completed logic-engine execution. This record is not a formal proof certificate.
Replay-visible semantic fields for a pinned logic contract. The artifact hash is the canonical semantic contract digest.
A product of drug metabolism via a CYP enzyme.
A defensive measure.
A monitoring failure report, never negative evidence.
Replay-visible specification of one exact monitor implementation and its input artifacts. This record does not claim that the monitor executed.

One execution attempt. Attempts never collapse, including retries: a second try is a second record, never an overwrite of the first. Credentials never enter the bundle (decision C6), so the request is bound by digest and cannot be replayed byte-for-byte without out-of-band credentials. That consequence is stated rather than discovered.
Content-addressed contract used by an external observer to interpret post-execution state. It specifies a check, not whether the result is true.
Metabolism of a Drug produces a Metabolite.

An identified actor that can bear protocol responsibility: a proposer, monitor, controller, or reviewer. Adopters register their actors as ProtocolActor records; responsible_actor_id on protocol records names one. The id slot stays a string range deliberately: actor records live in the adopter's graph, not in every ledger.
Immutable record produced by an identified activity. The fields encode record provenance but are not a claim of formal PROV-O conformance.
A rendering derived from a source. Derived, never a replacement.

A stable spatial identity over a raster. The selector is governed by a declared profile; W3C Web Annotation and IIIF are the first-party default and hold no privilege (decision C1). The selector itself is content-addressed rather than stored as a graph record (decision 2), so the coordinate contract stays the specification's and this schema does not fork it.
A typed, directed edge between two entities. Reified as a class so relations can carry metadata (strength, confidence, temporal validity).

Append-only human review. Overwrites nothing. A separate reviewer is an identity that did not produce the hypothesis under review (mandate B3); reviewer_id is a bare string because protocol-actor-registration is not implemented, so this schema records the claim and cannot check it.
Which reading is current, and why. Currency is not validity (decision C7): a demoted hypothesis remains a valid observation of the same bytes, it is simply not the selected one.

A continuously derived quality that emerges from patterns of Events between Entities. Aligned with BFO:Specifically Dependent Continuant (Quality) and SSN/SOSA:Observation. A Signal inheres in its bearer(s) — it does not exist independently. It is computed, not asserted: derived on demand from the Event log and Entity graph via a named algorithm. Domain projects define signal types, algorithms, and interpretation semantics. The Signal class captures the universal pattern: something measurable that emerges from activity, has a current value, and is recomputable from the underlying data.

bearer_id.description: ID of the entity (or relationship) this signal inheres in. Required because a Signal cannot exist without a bearer (BFO: dependent continuant).

raw_definition.description: Content-addressed record of a caller-declared byte identity used by evidence. It commits to a digest and a length; it does not read the bytes, so it proves neither byte identity, nor authenticity, nor truth.

Declared before ingest and frozen at it (decision C8). Carries the three per-class declarations that decisions C2, C3 and C4 each needed separately. A metric family chosen after seeing the scan is a metric family chosen to flatter it.
Exact original bytes. Never replaced by a normalized derivative.
Entity with a lifecycle status.
A Drug is metabolized by an Enzyme.
An ATT&CK tactic (attack phase).
An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique.
Timestamps for creation and last modification. Follows PROV-O temporal patterns.
Explicit UNKNOWN output paired atomically with a MonitorFailure. It is not a completed monitor result.
UNKNOWN authority output paired atomically with a MonitorFailure and bound to the exact action, actor, policy, and optional evaluated grant.

Structural carrier for a transition boundary preserving the precision established by evidence. Every non-exact variant carries the extracted reason why an exact boundary is unavailable. Malleus runtime validation enforces lexical and cross-field temporal semantics.
